function.name: LOAD_MAP
function.abstract: Recover of disk a MAP graph

description.p: This function recovers a MAP graph from disk. The MAP is an own format of Fenix that allows to contain graphs of 1, 8 or 16 bits per pixel in comprimed format, with transparent pixels, and optionally with an animation. The graphs of 8 bits have the palette of colours inside of MAP archive.

LOAD_MAP returns an entire number that identifies to MAP graph. It is possible to use then this value with any function that allows a graph like parameter, indicating the code 0 of library, or assing the numbert to variable .

function.note: It is only possible to visualize graphs of 16 bits if the current graph mode is of 16 bits. But it is possible to visualize graphs of 8 bits in mode of 16 bits.

There is only an active palette of colours in all time. Use only graphs of 8 bits that use the same palette of colours. Fenix will use automatically the palette of colours of the first graph recovered of disk and will ingore other palettes. Even in mode of 16 bits exists a palette of colours (but in these mode the palette only affects to graphs of 16 bits).
